name: El Cabaco (Spain)
description: Square flag horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of El Cabaco (a pick on blue and tools on yellow).
history: The arms of El Cabaco were published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 11 January 1994; the flag is square, of proportion 1:1, divided white over red and charged at its centre with the crowned municipal arms occupying 3/5 of the height of the cloth.

features.role: El Cabaco arms — pick on blue and mining tools on yellow
